# Summary
Part of the batch of 13 blog topic ideas drafted from the 49-post review on June 24-25 and saved to `blog-drafts\` (per the handoff: drafted, not published). Source: `blog-drafts\sewer-camera-inspection-cost.md`. Each draft carries a focus keyphrase, SEO title, meta, slug, internal link list, image alt ideas and external sources.

# Key facts
- **Focus keyphrase:** sewer camera inspection cost.
- **Status:** draft only; not in the July 21 live blog inventory, and no later publish record in this folder.
- Arizona cost guide. Prices are banned in new copy (Scott), and cost topics were deliberately left out of the Oct 1 plan.
